title: OAW code-map Stage 0-alpha questions (D24)

corpus.archive: git -c core.autocrlf=false -c core.eol=lf archive --format=tar 6481437 | tar -x -C EMPTY_DIR

scoring_rules: Gold paths are corpus-relative POSIX paths. A result under example/ whose bytes equal a file outside example/ counts as that file (generated copies), and repeated files keep their first rank.
Class d drops the two endpoints from the ranked list before scoring; gold is the set of intermediate modules of every accepted shortest chain.
top-1/top-5: a gold file at rank 1 / within ranks 1-5. MRR, precision and recall use the first 10 distinct files.
